In the background left, a yellow velvet armchair draped with a faux fur ivory throw is partially visible, accompanied by a large leafy monstera plant in a pink pot. A pink console or dresser is partially visible at far right, styled with a small vintage radio-shaped object, a vase with dried blooms, and a circular mirror. The palette is fully saturated color — hot pink, lemon yellow, forest green, sky blue, and white. Diffused daylight from a window at left provides even bright illumination across the scene.
